learning_outcomes.text: Acquire fundamental knowledge related to the main theoretical and applicative aspects of Bioengineering.

Include basic notions concerning measurement, the structure of biomedical instrumentation and its main electronic components, the problems of A/D conversion, and the acquisition and analysis of biomedical signals.
Apply principles learned on examples and understand their effect.
Understand what happens with independent judgment.

syllabus_topics: Concept to measurement and error of a measurement
Biomedical instrumentation. Sensors, operational amplifier, and filters
Basic concept of analogic and digital signals. The sampling of the analogue signal. A/D conversion. Nyquist theorem and sampling
Nature and presentation of the Biomedical signals
Notes on safety and risk in the use of biomedical equipment

assessment_methods.method: Written test with multiple choice questions

assessment_rules: The verification of student knowledge consists of a written test with multiple choice answers, potentially followed by an oral integration. The total score (out of 30) is based on correct answers to individual questions. Grading criteria range from 18-22/30 for basic knowledge, 23-25/30 for fair knowledge, 26-28/30 for good ability, and 28-30/30 for excellent knowledge. Honors (cum laude) are awarded for answering all written test questions correctly. Individualized exam arrangements are available for students with disabilities or specific learning disorders.
bibliography: Medical Instrumentation. Application And Design by John G. Webster
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Biomedica (Biomedical Engineering), classe L-9 R Ingegneria industriale
